_note: Physics parameters (m_a, m_b, d_a, d_b) are hardcoded in the scripts and NOT set here.
_eval_budget: SA=200, RBM=200, BO=50, PT=1000. Brute force at k=10 costs C(21,10)=352716 evaluations.

sa._note: 200 SDP evaluations. T_start tuned to cost function range [0.251, 0.375]. alpha=0.95 over 200 steps gives final T ~ 2.7e-5.

pt._note: 1000 SDP evaluations total (5 chains x 200 steps). Geometric ladder [0.1, 0.21, 0.45, 0.95, 2.0] gives neighbour ratio ~2.1, keeping swap acceptance above 20-30%.

bo._note: 50 SDP evaluations total (10 init + 40 iterations). Kept lean to preserve BO identity as sample-efficient method. candidates_per_iter=200 compensates for fewer iterations. num_trees controls the RandomForest surrogate.

rbm._note: 200 SDP evaluations, matching SA for direct comparison. T_start and alpha aligned with SA schedule. learning_rate/decay/n_mcmc_steps are SpinsSDP-internal (ADAM optimizer) and not configurable here.
